title: Review on Contribution Amounts by Employees to Self-help Groups
what_it_is: Review on Contribution Amounts by Employees to Self-help Groups

sections.label: Self-help group contribution rates
sections.summary: Self-help groups set contribution rates based on community needs, with higher earners contributing more, and rates reviewed when needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The contribution rates are determined by the respective self-help groups, based on the needs of their communities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: These rates are progressively packed with those earning higher incomes contributing more.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The self-help groups review their contribution rates when needed, taking into consideration their programme requirements and the prevailing economic situation faced by the communities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Individuals may choose to also contribute more than the rate set by self-help groups, by writing to the respective self-help groups.
